openIssues.issue: GCF backend has no authentication layer
openIssues.recommendation: Add API key authentication to the GCF. Options: 1) Require x-api-key header validated against a secret, 2) Use Firebase Auth tokens, 3) IP allowlisting for known Spectre servers.

openIssues.issue: GCF backend has no rate limiting
openIssues.recommendation: Implement rate limiting at the Cloud Functions level or add a Cloud Armor/API Gateway in front of the function.
Add API key or JWT authentication. At minimum, add rate limiting per IP.
